description: Application view model for user regions data (not stored as a database table), linked to region, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report user regions records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One object represents one user region result row.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user region.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this user region.

columns.name: regionId
columns.description: Reference to the region linked to this user region.

relationships.description: Each user region references one users (user).
Each user region references one region (region).

business_rules: Join to Region, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
UserRegions is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against UserRegions: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting user region records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id; regionId = Region.id.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
